gemini.title.singleplayer.tooltip: Pick or create a world. Gemini modules only run in single player.
gemini.title.multiplayer.tooltip: Open the server list. While sandbox mode is on, Gemini first explains how to switch itself off.
gemini.title.realms.tooltip: Open Minecraft Realms. Realms connections are refused while sandbox mode is on.
gemini.title.menu.tooltip: Open the module menu to set up modules, settings and key binds. Modules can only be switched on inside a single-player world.
gemini.title.search.tooltip: Find any module, setting, command or page by typing (Ctrl+K).
gemini.title.guide.tooltip: What changed in this version, the controls of both menus, every command, and how sandbox mode works.
gemini.title.disabled.tooltip: Gemini is switched off. Turn sandbox mode back on to set it up.
gemini.title.vanilla.tooltip: Use the vanilla title screen from now on. Its "Gemini menu" button brings this screen back.
gemini.title.theme.tooltip: Colour theme of the menus and the HUD. Click a colour to switch.
gemini.title.home.tooltip: Use the Gemini title screen instead of this one.
gemini.dock.menu.tooltip: Open the module menu: modules, settings, key binds, presets and quick search.
gemini.dock.hud.tooltip: Drag the HUD widgets into place.
gemini.dock.mods.tooltip: Find mods and resource packs on Modrinth without leaving the world.
gemini.dock.guide.tooltip: What changed in this version, controls, commands and about.
gemini.dock.panic.tooltip: Switch every module off at once. Also available as .panic and as the Panic module.
gemini.dock.keybinds.tooltip: Some keys are bound to more than one action. Open the key-bind report to see which.
gemini.keybinds.title: Keybind report
gemini.mods.title: Mods
gemini.mods.restart: Installed mods load next time you start Minecraft
gemini.title.mods.tooltip: Find mods and resource packs on Modrinth. Installed mods load next time you start Minecraft; resource packs can be turned on right away.
